meta.title: Warehouse Forklift Safety
meta.subtitle: Action Adventure · Key & Lock
meta.briefing: You're the new operator on the warehouse floor. Talk to the safety leads, collect the evidence that proves each procedure, dodge the hazards, and unlock each gate to earn your certification.

sourceElement.label: Safety Officer Dana
sourceElement.description: Welcome to the floor. Before you touch a forklift, you prove you know the pre-op checks. Collect the evidence, then take it to the gate.

sourceElement.label: Dock Supervisor Reyes
sourceElement.description: Second stage. Out here it's about right-of-way and load limits. Get me the proof and I'll open the dock.

sourceElement.label: Pre-Operation Inspection Log
sourceElement.description: A completed pre-op inspection log is required evidence before operating any forklift.
sourceElement.evidence: Operators must complete and sign a pre-operation inspection log at the start of every shift.

sourceElement.label: Seatbelt Engagement Proof
sourceElement.description: Seatbelt use is mandatory whenever the forklift is in motion.
sourceElement.evidence: The operator's seatbelt must be fastened before the forklift is moved.

sourceElement.label: Load Capacity Rating
sourceElement.description: The data plate load rating must never be exceeded.
sourceElement.evidence: Never exceed the rated load capacity shown on the forklift data plate.

sourceElement.label: Pedestrian Right-of-Way Sign-off
sourceElement.description: Pedestrians always have the right of way in shared aisles.
sourceElement.evidence: Pedestrians have the right of way; operators must yield in all shared walkways.

sourceElement.label: Perform a 360° walk-around
sourceElement.description: Step 1: walk a full circle around the forklift checking tires, forks, and leaks.
sourceElement.evidence: First, perform a 360-degree walk-around inspection before start-up.

sourceElement.label: Sound the horn at blind corners
sourceElement.description: Step 2: sound the horn when approaching intersections and blind corners.
sourceElement.evidence: Then sound the horn at every intersection and blind corner.

sourceElement.label: Lower the forks before travel
sourceElement.description: Step 3: keep forks low and tilted back while traveling.
sourceElement.evidence: Keep the forks lowered and tilted back whenever the forklift is moving.

sourceElement.label: Unsecured pallet spill
sourceElement.description: An unsecured load has spilled across the aisle — a struck-by and slip hazard.
sourceElement.evidence: Unsecured loads can spill and create struck-by hazards; secure loads before moving.

sourceElement.label: Blind-corner pedestrian
sourceElement.description: A pedestrian steps out from a blind corner — yield or you cause an incident.
sourceElement.evidence: Blind corners hide pedestrians; slow down and yield to avoid collisions.
